sources.verification: Codex takedown_routing independently read all ten complete EN/RU bodies, the fixture, checker and helper, five reports and review records. Its fresh check passed 10 MDX files, 64 anchors, 221 identical bilingual math spans and two inline executions; Python 3.9.7 stdout matched exactly. A separate oracle evaluated 55 complex-step derivatives (maximum gap 1.12e-16), independently fitted the two-row CNN head, recomputed decoder states and NLL with 50-digit Decimal arithmetic, and checked GRU/search/BLEU/count/finite-capacity calculations with exact arithmetic. Selected primary passages and four pinned PyTorch blobs were checked; historical LSTM/Gers coverage remained abstract/metadata only. Three findings were corrected and read back: RNN recoverability qualification, Russian complementary-gate wording, and the Kim channel-section locator. No remaining scoped blocker was found.
